what: Dev pseudo-label baseline, one entry per evidence-type combination
how_to_use: Match a case's evidence types to a signature. advice is the modal reading of POLICY.md for that combination; rule_advice splits it by which alerts fired, because the same documents answer different alerts differently. Where a type is dual-use (support_chat, staff_note, device_export, customer_email, bank_statement) the text decides, so check content_flags before using advice. needs_review marks combinations where the policy does not settle the answer from the files.

conventions.advice: suggested verdict and reason_code for the combination
conventions.rule_advice: same, restricted to the cases in the combination that raised those rules
conventions.heuristic_mix: share of the combination's cases that the content-aware classifier put on each verdict (calibration only, not ground truth)
conventions.confidence: high = one reading dominates and the documents are unambiguous; medium = a judgement call on dates/identity; low = the case turns on content the classifier cannot settle
conventions.cost_reminder: wrong CLOSE = 10, wrong RFI = 3, wrong ESC = 2-3
